result.stdout:
Usage: graphify-csharp --input <solution|project|file.cs> [options]

Options:
  -i, --input <path>              C# solution/project/file-based app to extract (required)
  -r, --root <path>               Repository root for stable paths
  -o, --output <path>             Graphify JSON output path
  -c, --configuration <name>      MSBuild configuration (default: Debug)
  -f, --target-framework <tfm>    Select one TFM when target selection is ambiguous
      --rebuild                  Ignore incremental cache and rebuild all projects
      --watch                    Keep a warm indexer and serve local refresh requests
      --watch-scan-interval <t>   Backup inventory interval (default: 00:05:00)
  -h, --help                      Show this help
